Package hu.bme.mit.theta.frontend.transformation.model.types.complex.compound

Class BitfieldSlice

java.lang.Object
hu.bme.mit.theta.frontend.transformation.model.types.complex.compound.BitfieldSlice
public final class BitfieldSlice extends Object
Read and write a bitfield that lives as a slice of a shared storage-unit cell (see BitfieldLayout). The cell is one packed integer; a member b:w at bit offset o is the w-bit field starting there. Works for both arithmetic encodings: a bitvector cell uses Extract/Concat (inherently logical), an integer cell uses the equivalent / 2^o mod 2^w / place-and-recombine arithmetic.

  • Field Details

    • CELL

      public static final String CELL
      Metadata stamped on a bitfield member's *read* expression, naming the cell it was sliced out of. An assignment whose left-hand side carries this must not overwrite the whole cell: it read-modify-writes just the field's bits (see write(hu.bme.mit.theta.core.type.Expr<?>, hu.bme.mit.theta.core.type.Expr<?>, int, int)).

    • IEEE_FLOAT

      public static final String IEEE_FLOAT
      Metadata marking a union member whose cell holds a floating-point value as its raw IEEE-754 bit pattern. The read is a reinterpretation (FpFromIeeeBv); an assignment through it must splice FpToIeeeBv of the right-hand side, not a plain integer cast.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • PACKED_CELL

      public static final String PACKED_CELL
      Metadata marking an expression as the *cell* of a union member that is one packed unit of bitfields (see CStruct#isPackedScalar). Reading a member of such a struct slices this cell instead of dereferencing it again, which is what makes the bitfield view and a sibling integer member (`raw`) name the same storage.
      See Also:

    • read

      public static Expr<?> read(Expr<?> cell, int bitOffset, int width, boolean signed)
      The value of the width-bit field at bitOffset within cell, in the cell's own type. Unsigned fields zero-extend; signed fields sign-extend from the field width.

    • write

      public static Expr<?> write(Expr<?> cell, Expr<?> value, int bitOffset, int width)
      The new value of cell after storing value's low width bits into the field at bitOffset, leaving the other bits untouched. value must already be the cell's type (the assignment casts the right-hand side to the member's base type).
